Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.cards.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbandonedShipCard, AbandonedStationCard, CombatZoneCard, EpidemicCard, MeteorSwarmCard, OpenSpaceCard, PiratesCard, PlanetsCard, SlaversCard, SmugglersCard, StardustCard
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a generic card used in the game. This class is abstract and defines the common properties and methods that all specific card types must implement or inherit. Instances of this class are deserialized from JSON using Jackson.

      public abstract String[] getAsciiArt()
